board.name: Hawaii Medical Board (DCCA Professional and Vocational Licensing)

cycleYears.reason: Renewal by January 31 of each even-numbered year

agreement.text: Each supervising physician submits a signed supervision statement to the board, and the supervising physician's license must be renewed before the PA's. The board is notified within ten days when supervision ends; the PA and physician keep written guidelines for medical record review.

board.name: Hawaii Board of Nursing (DCCA Professional and Vocational Licensing)

cycleYears.reason: Licenses expire June 30 of every odd-numbered year.

options.text: National certification or recertification related to your practice role
At least two semester credits of post-licensure academic education related to nursing practice
Precepting a nursing student or new employee in an organized preceptorship of at least one hundred twenty hours
Principal or co-investigator on a board preapproved nursing research or evidence-based practice project
Authoring or coauthoring a peer reviewed nursing or health related article, book or chapter
Nursing education presentations totaling at least five contact hours of instruction
A board recognized nurse residency program, or a similar learning activity the board recognizes

certificationInLieu.note: CE earned for recertification by a recognized national certifying body within the biennium may be accepted in lieu.

exemption.question: Are you renewing prescriptive authority (do you hold prescriptive authority)?
exemption.text: The 30 hours (22 in your practice specialty, 8 in pharmacology) are for APRNs renewing prescriptive authority.

condition.question: Do you hold prescriptive authority?
condition.description: Hawaii requires current national certification to renew prescriptive authority.
